ranking.reason: When colors match, using V2[j]+vi assumes V2[j] excludes color ci, but C2/V2 are reset and rebuilt from j-1 states and may still carry color ci, producing invalid sums.
Setting V1[0]=-INF on same-color repeat discards the best alternative; should fall back to second-best-style value, losing valid states.
Non-strict >= on ties shifts the top value into second place even when equal, can push wrong color pairing into C2.
elif with >= may overwrite C2 with equal-valued candidate of differing tie order; boundary of strict/non-strict comparison suspect.
Resetting C2/V2 each iteration discards previously tracked second-best; reconstruction from j-1 may not recover it.
